status: Proposed from formulas and operational reserves; freeze this file and its hash before reserved validation. No calibration CSV used to choose coefficients.
scope: Native-coordinate/native-amplitude Jacobi GST, degree m>=2, requested precision >=24 bits; Legendre and left-Radau interior consumers. Finite measured regimes only, not a proved uniform bound.

definitions.m: Jacobi degree; Radau order minus one
definitions.a,b: Exact represented input parameters of Jacobi; for Radau use original alpha,beta and mathematical shift a=alpha,b=beta+1
definitions.p_i: v_i/mass, where v_i is the reference Jacobi weight; v_i=(1+x_i)*w_Radau_i for Radau interiors

node_budget.series_selector: Only actual endpoint-series roots: upper extreme when a<T(-0.9), lower extreme when b<T(-0.9)
node_budget.symmetric_phase_term: Retained; exact symmetric startup does not remove coefficient/propagation rounding

normalization_envelope.l,r: Independent outward brackets of all reference roots, strictly inside (-1,1)
normalization_envelope.l_o,r_o: Independent outward brackets of ordinary roots after excluding roots actually recomputed by endpoint series
normalization_envelope.KX_global: max(KX_ordinary,KX_series), omitting a term if that class of roots is absent
normalization_envelope.reason: Interval geometry bounds K_J_i*C_i and G_i for every reference root; entropy sum(p_i*abs(log(p_i)))<=log(m) bounds the remaining normalized mean without all-root references. This bounds the engineering allowances, not unsampled observed errors.

failure_policy: Budgets must be frozen before reserved validation; retain all raw errors and original test failures.
A relative budget >=1/8 or nonpositive summation denominator is inconclusive, not an accuracy pass.
Structural/index/reference-stability failures remain failures; valid output semantics and working/output representability are checked separately.
Tighter preserved regression tests and the frozen Legendre n=61 boundary check remain independently required.
Do not count sampled maxima as all-node error bounds. The normalization term uses interval and entropy bounds on the model.
Asymptotic public routes require their own assessment; they do not validate the GST kernel.
Below 24 bits, assess Float32 calculation and final conversion separately; wider/compensated production arithmetic is not permitted.
